import math
def ground_pt(u, v, cam_x, cam_y, cam_yaw):
    H = 1.55
    d_fwd = H * 256.0 / (v - 256.0)
    d_right = H * (u - 256.0) / (v - 256.0)
    rad = math.radians(cam_yaw)
    wx = cam_x + d_fwd * math.sin(rad) + d_right * math.cos(rad)
    wy = cam_y + d_fwd * math.cos(rad) - d_right * math.sin(rad)
